mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the plural form of medium, which (broadly speaking) describes any channel of communication."
Media is the plural form of medium, which (broadly speaking) describes any channel of communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important and effective print media of mass communication."
Newspaper is one of the most important and effective print media of mass communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the phenomenon just described of people thinking they are more immune to media influence than others."
The third-party effect is the phenomenon just described of people thinking they are more immune to media influence than others.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art of obtaining agreement between countries who need to cooperate to produce results in which each has an interest."
Diplomacy is the art of obtaining agreement between countries who need to cooperate to produce results in which each has an interest.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a global computer network providing a variety of information and communication facilities, consisting of interconnected networks using standardized communication protocols."
Internet is a global computer network providing a variety of information and communication facilities, consisting of interconnected networks using standardized communication protocols.

Print Media Print media can be defined as the industry associated with the printing and distribution of news through newspapers, magazines and journals.

Final issue worthy of note is the politics of representation in media industry and content.
______ refers to media-induced change that is counter to the desired change.
The boomerang effect refers to media-induced change that is counter to the desired change.

Broadcasting is the distribution of audio and video content to a dispersed audience via any electronic mass communication medium but typically one using the electromagnetic spectrum in a one-to-many model.
